title: Wilds of Eldraine Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Redtooth Keep
entities.description: A keep in Eldraine whose curse could only be broken by a mystical rose that blooms in moonlight.

entities.name: Goddric
entities.description: A figure who revealed his true identity and doused redcap invaders in dragonfire at the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh.

entities.name: Delverhaugh
entities.description: Site of the Grand Ball, which a redcap raid threatened.

entities.name: Redcaps
entities.description: Raiders who threatened the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh and fought dwarves.

entities.name: High King Kenrith
entities.description: A High King whose armies followed him into the afterlife.

entities.name: Sturwynn
entities.description: A Boundary Lands ranger who describes the Regal Bunnicorn.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: A predator whose demise is retold in stories.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A character who grows taller with each retelling of Agatha's demise.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: A character who grows stronger with each retelling of Agatha's demise.

entities.name: Rankle
entities.description: A prankster who laughs harder the louder his victims scream.

entities.name: Imodane, the Pyrohammer
entities.description: A character who is spoken of with the claim that the realm needs a ruler, not a boy playing king.

entities.name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
entities.description: A character who speaks to a victim about beauty sleep.

entities.name: Rowan, Scion of War
entities.description: A character who refuses to keep negotiating with her brother and wants to rebuild Eldraine with power.

entities.name: Will, Scion of Peace
entities.description: A character who favors turning enemies into allies over charging at them.

entities.name: Yenna, Redtooth Regent
entities.description: Regent of Redtooth who calls her people both bloom and thorn.

entities.name: Embereth
entities.description: A place whose fire the Heartflame Duelist says will never be doused.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: A wearer of the Crown of Winter, whose icy kingdom spread as her heart grew colder.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane Rowan wishes to rebuild.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Monsters the Pollen-Shield Hare can drive off.

events.summary: Goddric reveals his true identity and douses redcap invaders in dragonfire when a redcap raid threatens the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh.
events.quote: When a redcap raid threatened the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh, Goddric had no choice but to reveal his true identity and douse the invaders in dragonfire.

events.summary: High King Kenrith's armies follow him into the afterlife.
events.quote: High King Kenrith's armies followed him into the afterlife, ready to charge at his command.

events.summary: Retellings of Agatha's demise make Kellan taller and Ruby stronger, while the core story stays the same.
events.quote: With every retelling of Agatha's demise, Kellan got taller and Ruby got stronger.

events.summary: Dwarves fight the redcaps with anything within reach.
events.quote: With no time to gather weapons, the dwarves fought the redcaps with anything within reach.

events.summary: Rowan declares she will rebuild Eldraine herself with power rather than negotiate with her brother.
events.quote: I will rebuild Eldraine myself—the old way, with power.

events.summary: Hylda's icy kingdom spreads while she wears the crown, and her heart grows colder.
events.quote: With each day she wore the crown, her icy kingdom spread, and her heart grew ever colder.
